name: probe-hooks
description: Probe's hook proxy: hands each hook event to the Probe service on this machine. Its files never change.

hooks.command: /bin/bash -c 'R="${KIMI_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; R="${R%/}"; [ -f "$R/hooks/hook.py" ] || exit 0; command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec python3 -S -B "$R/hooks/hook.py" --harness kimi_code --event SessionStart --timeout 60'
